subject: Urgent: Candidate feedback dispute & offer coordination — Alex Jenkins
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate packet for Alex Jenkins — panel shows split on level

Diego / Vivek —

Quick update on Alex Jenkins (Aurelia AI referral). We finished panel interviews yesterday and the feedback is mixed on leveling: two interviewers scored "Senior" while one scored "IC3" and wrote concerns about system design depth. Attached are the panel notes, resume, and the candidate's take-home artifacts.

Hiring manager (Vivek) has pushed for Senior; recruiting is prepared to extend an offer at L3 unless leadership/HR want calibration. Finance has asked us to hold the official offer until we align on level because comp bands differ materially.

Can you confirm next steps? If there's a formal appeal/clarification process we should start, please advise — candidate is available for a second system design if helpful but is on a tight timeline.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
Attachments: jenkins_resume.pdf, interview_panel_notes.docx, takehome_results.zip

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate packet for Alex Jenkins — panel shows split on level

Marissa —

Thanks for the packet. I'm escalating this to HR/careers because I believe the IC3 rating here is inconsistent with the interview notes and the take-home. Alex led the design trade-offs in the take-home, demonstrated clear ownership and shipped a reference implementation — that aligns with our Senior expectations.

Requesting the following from HR:
- Immediate calibration with the level rubric (please confirm which rubric version was used).
- Temporary pause on sending the L3 offer until calibration completes.
- If calibration supports Senior, please approve an L4 band offer (salary + 15% equity uplift) so we can move quickly; budget was pre-approved for a Senior hire in Q2.

This candidate is a priority for my team. If we don't resolve today, I recommend we offer a verbal L3 to keep them warm while the formal review completes — but I prefer HR rule the final level.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Engineering Manager, Compute Services | Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate packet for Alex Jenkins — panel shows split on level

Diego / team —

Received. I'll run a quick calibration today. To make this efficient, please fill and return the attached leveling_appeal_form.pdf with the following evidence:
1) Specific rubric items where you believe the IC3 score is incorrect (quote panel comments).
2) One-paragraph summary of candidate impact examples (from take-home / interview).
3) Confirmation of approved budget range for Senior (if available).

Marissa — please also attach the raw interviewer scorecards (not just summary) and timestamped Slack excerpts if any. Once I have the packet I'll loop in Compensation for a band confirmation.

Evelyn Hart
Head of People Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: leveling_appeal_form.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate packet for Alex Jenkins — panel shows split on level

Evelyn —

Filling this out now. Attaching: full interviewer scorecards (individual sheets), the raw take-home runbook and logs, and a Slack thread where one interviewer noted that the candidate "owns cross-team scope" and flagged their system boundary thinking. The interviewer who scored IC3 left a short note: "Wanted deeper latency micro-optimizations."

Notes for the appeal form (draft):
- Rubric: Demonstrates ownership across service boundaries, shipped reference impl, mentorship examples during panel.
- Impact: Candidate reduced a previous team's end-to-end latency by 18% in a similar role (claim backed in take-home).
- Budget: I have verbal approval from finance for Senior headcount in Q2; comp team needs HR sign-off to finalize salary band.

Attachments included: interview_panel_notes.docx, takehome_results.zip, comp_table.xlsx

We are trying to avoid delaying the candidate more than 48 hours. If HR needs a second live system design interview with a neutral interviewer, we can schedule it tomorrow morning.

Marissa Cole
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate packet for Alex Jenkins — panel shows split on level

Evelyn / team —

Short note from the hiring manager: I observed Senior-level system decomposition and product judgment across interviews and in the take-home. I support Diego's request for Senior (L4) and recommend offering at the top of the L4 band given market comp. Happy to take a quick calibration call if helpful.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director of Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Resolution: Alex Jenkins leveling & offer path

Team —

Thank you for the quick turnaround and the documentation. Calibration complete: based on the rubric and corroborating evidence (take-home + two Senior panel ratings + manager endorsement), HR is approving an upward leveling to Senior (L4). Compensation has authorized an offer at the L4 band with the following guidance: base + 15% equity uplift relative to L3 proposal and target cash at 90th percentile of the L4 band.

Next steps:
1) Marissa: please prepare the formal offer packet with the L4 comp figures and send via DocuSign. HubSpot candidate record: HS-987234.
2) Diego & Vivek: please review and confirm the comp table in comp_table.xlsx; if you both sign off within 6 hours, recruiting can issue the DocuSign link to the candidate today.
3) I'll notify People Ops / Compensation to mark the role as Senior in our headcount tracker and update audit logs.

Marissa — attaching the DocuSign prep link and a checklist. Please copy Laura for executive notification when the offer is sent.

Evelyn Hart
Head of People Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: comp_table.xlsx, offer_docusign_prep.txt
Related Links: https://hubspot.company/crm/candidate/HS-987234, https://docusign.com/rs/offer/HS-987234
